label: BEING_1, as the entity of a thing: BEING_1 in the sense in which a thing is a BEING_1: the entity…
term: being (ens), as the entity of a thing
definition: Being in the sense in which a thing is a being: the entity of a thing, as divided by the ten categories, convertible with 'thing'. In this sense no privation is a being, so evil is not a being. The Lean domain `Being` ranges over beings in this sense; nothing restricts it to bodies.
note: Lean locator: MotionModel.Being is the primitive carrier type, not the whole MotionModel or a predicate establishing which real things are beings. The chosen carrier interpretation is supplied by an application; neither existence nor the categorical reading follows from the field declaration alone. That applicability remains OPEN.

formal_gap.meaning: MotionModel.Being is the carrier type of a model: the things the model's predicates are about, read as beings in the sense of entities (whatever is a thing, as divided by the categories). A model supplies the type; Lean only fixes that its elements are what MovedIn, MovesIn, InAct and the other fields are said of. Membership in the carrier is not itself a claim that something exists actually: actual being is the separate predicate InAct x esse (DEF-ESSE).
examples: Socrates, a fire, a piece of wood, read as elements of the carrier in an application of the prima via.

In the finite prima via models (TruthCore/Results/Aquinas/SummaTheologiae/PrimaViaModels.lean) the carrier is a three-element type such as StrongBeing with elements g, f, x; these are formal interpretations, not claims about which real things are beings.
exclusions: Being as the truth of a proposition (DEF-BEING-AS-TRUTH-OF-A-PROPOSITION): 'there is evil' is the truth of a sentence, and sentences are a different Lean type (DISAMB-BEING).
Privations such as evil or blindness are not elements of the carrier in this sense.

Respects (MotionModel.Respect): in the intended interpretation a respect is not a being of the model; Lean supplies the two carriers as independently given types without making them distinct (a model may use the same type for both), so this is an interpretive requirement, not a consequence of the declaration.
open_obligations: Which real things the carrier ranges over, and that the categorical reading applies, are supplied by an application and remain OPEN.

Whether being is said univocally or analogically of the elements is a separate axis (DISAMB-BEING-UNIVOCITY); nothing in the carrier type decides it, and 'more or less in being' is the separate comparative MoreIn esse.
No formalization candidate: a carrier type is a parameter of every model and has no definition from other vocabulary.
